01 About

Who I Am

I'm Aimad Ul Islam, a Computer Science graduate from the University of Peshawar, Pakistan, with a growing specialisation in cybersecurity, network security, and security operations.

My journey began with a fascination for how systems communicate — and how they can be compromised, defended, and hardened. I hold Cisco Networking Academy certifications in Networking Essentials, Introduction to Cybersecurity, Linux Essentials, and Ethical Hacker. I've earned the Cisco Learn-A-Thon 2026 Achievement Award, completed a Mastercard Cybersecurity Job Simulation, and trained in Digital Forensics & Incident Response (DFIR) with BlueCapeSecurity.

Career Objective: To leverage my education, Cisco credentials, and hands-on DFIR training in a dedicated SOC Analyst, Security Researcher, or Network Security Engineer role.

Experience Summary: 7+ years of experience managing technology platforms, remote operations, digital systems, and hands-on cybersecurity labs.

Network Security SOC Operations Ethical Hacking Digital Forensics Incident Response Threat Intelligence Penetration Testing Malware Analysis OSINT Cloud Security
